dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Yep, no books. I'm a law-abiding citizen, so even if smuggling knowledge could make me rich, I still wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: After all, you can't keep making money when you're pushing up daisies.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Besides, making money is easy. Even with half my talent, you should still be able to make as much as the Homayanis.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Heh, if the Akademiya could have made an argument to get me to enroll that was half as convincing as my own sales pitch, I wouldn't have turned them down on the spot back then.
